messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated warmup failures + container crashes observed in rm-infer-prod (us-east1). 500/502 spikes, warmup replay errors. Paging oncall. https://internal.incidents/redwood/1769464321

pager: Paging @maria and @alex. Urgency: P1. Please acknowledge.

maria: Ack. Looking at node events and nvml now. Crash loops on warmup workers in pool-warmup-3.

alex: I'm seeing repeated errors when loading dialog-core:v3.0 during deserialization and then CUDA failures. Samples:
```
[2026-03-15T18:12:05Z] warmup.deserialize ERROR: tar: unexpected EOF while reading header
[2026-03-15T18:12:05Z] serve.load WARN: artifact gzip header mismatch, aborting
[2026-03-15T18:12:07Z] cuda alloc failed: cuMemAlloc failed with CU_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY
[2026-03-15T18:12:08Z] runtime: kernel compile timed out after 45s
```

sanjay: That artifact size for v3.0 is 2.1GB. We recently toggled ENABLE_COMPILE_CACHE=1 which may be thrashing compile subsystem on older nodes. Also saw nvlink errors on a subset.

kevin: Pause rollout of v3.0 canary immediately. Rerouting 100% to v2.7.

ops-bot: Command executed: reroute --model dialog-core --from v3.0 --to v2.7 --percent 100 --initiated-by kevin

incident-bot: Handoff: @alex -> @maria (infra baseline) and @sanjay (runtime).

maria: Taking node-level mitigation: cordon warmup nodes with >2 restarts in 15m, reprovision with updated NV driver 525.85 and no nvlink bonding. Also spinning up +3 warmup instances with larger GPU mem (A100-40GB) to absorb load.

alex: Runtime mitigations: temporarily set WARMUP_CONCURRENCY=1 on pool-warmup-3 and WARMUP_VERIFY_RETRIES=3 so we retry artifact fetches instead of failing fast. Also disable ENABLE_COMPILE_CACHE on warmup pool.

ops-bot: set-env --pool pool-warmup-3 WARMUP_CONCURRENCY=1 WARMUP_VERIFY_RETRIES=3 ENABLE_COMPILE_CACHE=0 --by alex

alex: Found uploader traces showing presigned URL expiry mid-upload -> partial artifacts (tar truncated). Snippet:
```
uploader ERROR: presign url expired during multipart upload part 3
upload status: aborted
manifest checksum: expected 9f8e7d6c... actual: ffffffffff...
```

sanjay: That explains the tar EOF and gzip header mismatch. CI changed presign TTL from 1h to 5m in recent deploy. Reverting TTL and forcing reupload.

kevin: Reverted presign TTL in artifact service to 1h and kicked off reupload of dialog-core:v3.0 from the canonical build bucket.

customer-success-bot: CS ping: Sent note to 6 customers in impacted region about transient 502s and longer cold-starts. No API keys or data exfiltrated. ETA for next update: 20m.

maria: Early impact metrics: warmup failure rate peaked 18% for the region, container respawn increased by 3x. After pause + node reprovision + concurrency change failure rate down to 4%.

alex: Suggested longer-term fix: add an artifact verification step post-upload (verify checksum + untar dry-run), and increase warmup artifact fetch retries in client. Also gate large models to nodes with >=32GB GPU memory.

sanjay: For immediate safety we should also add a fallback route: if warmup fails, route to a quantized variant dialog-core:v3.0-q8a. That reduces mem needs and buys stability.

kevin: Implementing fallback routing for warmup failures and creating traffic rule: fallback-if-warmup-fail -> dialog-core:v3.0-q8a. ops-bot confirms.

ops-bot: route-add --if warmup_fail dialog-core:v3.0 dialog-core:v3.0-q8a --by kevin

alex: Collecting all relevant artifacts for postmortem: artifact-uploader logs, presign config change, kernel compile logs, nvml traces, container crash dumps. Bundling to s3://incidents-bundles/1769464321/logs.tar.gz

maria: Creating ticket INC-1769464321 for PM/SE/customer notifications and linking to this thread.

incident-bot: Severity downgraded to Sev2. Notifying eng-oncall and product-alerts.

kevin: Recovery plan summary:
1) paused v3.0 canary (done)
2) cordon/reprovision flapping nodes + driver update (in progress)
3) revert presign TTL + reupload artifact to stable bucket (in progress)
4) enable artifact verification and staged validation in isolated warmup nodes
5) reintroduce v3.0 with 1% canary -> 5% -> 25% with extended warmup validation windows and fallback route in place

alex: I'll post final resolution and link to postmortem doc once the bundle is uploaded and ticket created. Thanks everyone. :raised_hands:

incident-bot: log bundle created: s3://incidents-bundles/1769464321/logs.tar.gz (attached to INC-1769464321)
